hero_tagline: Looking for a licensed general contractor to do a kitchen remodel, finish your basement, build a deck, or need help with some other construction project? Call Alan at American Legacy Contracting. American Legacy Contracting has been building in Utah county for over 14 years. He also has great electricians and plumbers for whatever you might need. He is a top rated contractor that Build zoom ranks above 74,376 other contractors in Utah. Placing them in the top 1% of general contractors to work with and they live just down the road.
about_text: Based in Payson, Utah Alan Barben, (the owner) is fully licensed and insured, he also has a Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, as well as an Applied Science degree in Construction Management. He has worked as a residential home builder, a commercial construction manager and has worked in all the major trades including framing, electrical, heating and air conditioning and plumbing. Alan only uses subcontractors that he would trust to work in his own home. Don't know if he can help you? Give him a call or send him a text and he'll let you know if he can help, or possibly just refer you to a trusted friend that can.
